newsitem.title: USA: America Online sets guarantee for on-line shoppers.
newsitem.headline: America Online sets guarantee for on-line shoppers.

text.p: America Online Inc said Thursday it is introducing a new program designed to protect its members when making purchases with a credit card from AOL approved merchants.

Called AOL Guarantee, it is part of a series of improvements being made to America Online's shopping area or Marketplace Channel. The changes include a graphic redesign of the area to make it easier to navigate, America Online said.
The company said AOL Guarantee promises protection from credit card fraud and 100 percent customer satisfaction or a money-back guarantee.
That promise is offered only on purchases made with a group of "certified merchants," America Online spokeswoman Robin Patton said.

There are about 500 businesses that sell products online that are accessible through America Online. However, of those, only about 50 are considered certified merchants since their transactions are conducted solely online -- rather than by directing consumers to call a telephone number or to access the businesses through another network, Patton said.

The announcement came the day after AT&T Corp said it is offering a secure way of transacting electronic commerce over the Internet and was offering a series of security guarantees to entice customers into the service.
America Online said that the private nature of its network, along with its "rigorous process" for selecting merchants "substantially reduces any risk of credit card fraud."

If a member of America Online discovers unauthorized use of his or her credit card, the member can be protected from any liability if he or she alerts the credit card issuer promptly, the company said.
America Online said that if the credit card company does not waive the usual liability of up to $50, it will reimburse the customer.

America Online's Patton said the chief difference between its guarantee and that offered by AT&T Corp is that AT&T guarantees only purchases made with its credit card. In contrast, the America Online guarantee covers purchases made with its certified merchants over its network, she said.
Some of the certified merchants include Starbucks Corp, Omaha Steaks, Eddie Bauer and Tower Records.
